content.thinking:
I'm looking at the finding that 5.3, which would let a licensed MSB be approved, never gets to decide anything, since 5.2 escalates every MSB. One option is to leave things as they are and send every MSB to EDD, even with a verified licence. The other is to exempt licensed MSBs with a verified licence from the 5.2 escalation, which means narrowing the industry-restricted condition so it covers only crypto or unlicensed MSBs.

I'm weighing whether an MSB with an unverified licence should be left to escalate, which would make it incomplete instead, or whether it should default to escalation. Matching the id-verified rule, I'd treat "no" or unknown as escalate, which settles the case when the licence status is unknown.

I'm also considering a third option: leave the licensed-MSB rule in place but treat 5.3 as guidance for EDD reviewers rather than an L1 decision, so the rule comes out of the L1 set. Its outcomes would match the first option, since no case changes, so this would only clear the finding.

I'm settling on two options: either keep every money services business going to EDD, or exempt those with a verified licence from the 5.2 escalation. I'll drop the third option, since it would give the same outcomes as keeping things as they are. The open question is whether a verified-licence MSB should still go to EDD under 5.2 or be approvable under 5.3 when nothing else applies.

I'm settling the wording of the second option: a verified-licence MSB would skip the 5.2 referral and could be approved if nothing else applies, while unverified or unchecked licences still get referred. I'm also checking that the rule's condition gives the right result when the industry is unknown.

parsed.question: When a money services business's state licence has been verified, should it still be referred to Enhanced Due Diligence under 5.2, or can it be approved under 5.3 if nothing else in the procedure applies?

options.option: No, refer every money services business to EDD
options.says: 5.2 refers every money services business to EDD, whether or not its licence has been verified, so 5.3 never decides a case on its own.

options.option: Yes, a verified licence skips the 5.2 referral
options.says: Under 5.2, a money services business whose state licence has been verified is not referred to EDD and can be approved if nothing else applies; one whose licence is unverified or not yet checked is still referred, and virtual currency businesses are always referred.

rule.text: Restricted industries (money services businesses, virtual currency): escalate.
